facts.fact: Digital transition minister Seghrouchni said at the opening of the ministry's Cloud Week that the ministry is drawing up a 2025-2030 cloud roadmap whose first pillar is a national Cloud First policy that will make cloud the priority for all new public-administration IT projects, steered by a national Cloud First steering committee.
facts.system: National Cloud First policy / Cloud services roadmap 2025-2030

MAR.note: Only a passing reference to national data protection legislation; no standing, authority or application stated.

facts.fact: Minister Seghrouchni said the cloud roadmap's second objective is a secure, ordered move of public data to the cloud, in line with national data protection law and qualified providers, including a national sovereign cloud infrastructure for the state's sensitive information systems.

MAR.note: A sovereign cloud is planned; no data centre in service or its owner stated.
